bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

Following the departure of now-former NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, a new report by The Wall Street Journal (via Wccftech) has emerged alleging that NVIDIA artificially inflated the ongoing GPU and memory shortage by investing in AI startups that would go on to buy NVIDIA GPUs and build data centers....

This discussion is useful as a map of questions and reactions, not as independent proof. The most reliable takeaway comes from comparing Nvidia allegedly engineered scarcity by funding AI startups to buy its GPUs with the primary evidence it cites.
